Today however I went for material shopping and even in a not so full shop, I received no assistance in purchase. I was in fact actively misled into making a wrong purchase. featured_reviews.name: Janak Bishwakarma

Honestly, one of the best tattoo experiences I’ve had! 🔥
The studio has such a positive vibe the moment you enter, and everything is maintained super clean and hygienic ✨
which made me feel completely comfortable.
The artist really knows their craft they listened carefully, gave great suggestions, and made sure every detail was perfect. You can tell they genuinely care about their work and their clients.
The whole session was smooth, relaxed, and actually enjoyable 😄
I walked out with a tattoo I absolutely love ❤️
Highly recommend this place to anyone thinking about getting inked — great experience, great people, and definitely worth coming back again

featured_reviews.name: Harshad Palande
featured_reviews.review_text: Went in for my second tattoo and had a wonderful experience, just like the first time. The artist is incredibly talented..very raw, natural, and guided by great instinct, which really reflects in the final work. The entire process was smooth and comfortable. I’d highly recommend this place to anyone planning to get a tattoo. Big shoutout to the whole team for their amazing work🙌

featured_reviews.name: Sheeja Raghavan
featured_reviews.review_text: This was my first tattoo and I was very much nervous and neither did I have any clue on how my ideas can be bought into a design, Shaikh really helped with that and designed a custom tattoo for me. He was talking with me throughtout the session to make me comfortable. He guided me very well about the importance of after care of the tattoo. It was a really great experience and trust me it was not painful at all:).....Thanku Shaikh 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Smruti Tawde
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently got my flat piercing done at Skininks and had a great experience. This was actually my second piercing with them, and just like the first time, everything was very smooth and professional. Shalini and Sheikh were both very patient and made me feel comfortable throughout the process. They explained the placement and aftercare clearly, and the hygiene standards were excellent. The piercing itself was quick and almost painless. Always a good experience here—would definitely recommend Skininks to anyone looking to get a piercing done!

featured_reviews.name: Angela Rychlowska
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Skin Inks in Powai to get my ears pierced, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the moment I walked in, the studio had a welcoming and professional vibe. The staff were fantastic, friendly, approachable, and clearly skilled at what they do.

🌟 Overall: A five-star experience.

featured_reviews.name: Somdatta Dhar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Deliberately took time before posting this review. I got my tattoo done on 15th February 2026, and even after three months, it still looks as good as new.
Neat work by Shalini — the tattoo has been highly appreciated in my social circle. Since it was my first tattoo, I was a bit apprehensive initially, but the team was patient and guided me through every step. The aftercare instructions were also explained clearly.
There was very little irritation during the first week, and the tattoo healed beautifully. Thank you, Skin Inks.
